name: force-backup-journal
title: Preserve force-install backup records across interrupted installs
description: The machine installer records --force backup entries only when the receipt commits (installer/machinescope.py phase 3), while the intent journal it writes before the first write carries payloadDigest and planned paths only. A forced install interrupted after a .bak is taken but before the receipt commits therefore leaves a backup no later run can attribute or restore. Carry backup records in the intent journal (or an equivalent pre-write record) so an interrupted forced install is recoverable. Filed from 08-09-thin-machine-installer.
creator: sdelmas
